rules.description: A Cubit contains multiple unrelated user flows.
rules.fix_strategy: Split into one Cubit per independent user flow inside presentation/cubits/<flow>/.

rules.description: Usage of raw Flutter widgets like Text, TextButton, ElevatedButton, OutlinedButton, TextFormField, Image.asset, Image.network, SnackBar.
rules.fix_strategy: Replace with framework counterparts (AppText, AppButton, AppFormField, AppImage, EasyLoading, etc.).

rules.description: Hardcoded string literals or numbers found in UI or logic.
rules.fix_strategy: Extract to a constant or reuse an existing constant from the framework.

rules.description: Creating new TextStyle objects instead of using predefined typography getters.
rules.fix_strategy: Use the closest typography getter and apply .copyWith(color: ...) if needed.

rules.description: A class with the same name and responsibility already exists.
rules.fix_strategy: Refactor to reuse the existing class.

rules.description: Multiple or conflicting registrations in GetIt (services_locator.dart).
Files placed outside their designated layer/folder according to Clean Architecture.
rules.fix_strategy: Move files to correct folders (e.g., UI to presentation/screens/widgets).

rules.description: Usage of raw SizedBox, raw EdgeInsets, raw Radius, raw Icon size, or raw Container dimensions without the detected responsive system extensions.
rules.fix_strategy: Automatically map the raw dimensions to the generic responsive system rules specified in framework.json (e.g. .w, .h, .r).

rules.description: Private UI builder methods are forbidden (e.g. _buildCard).
rules.fix_strategy: Extract the method into its own Widget class in a separate file.
Extract business UI out of the screen file into screen_body.dart or separate widgets.

rules.description: A screen body widget exceeds 150 lines.
rules.fix_strategy: Split large UI sections (Column, ListView) into smaller widgets.
Split the widget into smaller, more focused reusable widgets.

rules.description: ScreenBody class is defined inside the *_screen.dart file.
